# Indikator 6

Indikator 6 is one of the quality indicators tracked in Denmark's ADHD-databasen (the national ADHD register), measuring the share of treatment courses ("behandlingsforløb") in which a patient is in treatment with ADHD medication [^src1]. It specifically targets children and young people under 18 in the treatment population, based on at least two redeemed prescriptions [^src2]. The indicator sits alongside Indikator 5 (which tracks psychoeducation uptake) as one of two key measures for this age group in the database's 2024 annual report, covering the assessment period 01.04.2024 to 31.03.2025 [^src2].

Nationally, Indikator 6 achieved 68 % fulfilment (confidence interval 66–69 %) for the period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, an improvement on the 63 % recorded in both 2023/24 and 2022/23 [^src1]. In absolute terms, the Danish ADHD treatment population comprised 5,222 courses in this period [^src2], of which 3,536 courses among children and young people under 18 involved ADHD medication treatment — corresponding to the reported 68 % [^src2].

Regional performance varied considerably: Region Hovedstaden reached 67 %, Region Sjælland 56 %, Region Syddanmark 72 %, Region Midtjylland 58 %, and Region Nordjylland 82 % [^src2]. Despite this variation, Indikator 6 performed notably better than Indikator 5, which showed particularly low national fulfilment (33 %) [^src2] — a contrast the report's chunk context highlights explicitly.

Looking ahead, the database's steering group ("styregruppen") has considered moving Indikator 6 into supplementary material in future reports, a proposal that Region Hovedstaden has endorsed [^src3]. This reflects a broader theme in the 2024 annual report: most indicators still fall well short of the database's development goal of ≥ 90 %, prompting ongoing revision of the indicator set to better reflect clinical practice.

## Claims

**Performance**
- Indikator 6 opfyldelse var 68 (66-69) % for perioden 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025, sammenlignet med 63 % for 2023/24 og 63 % for 2022/23 [^src1] (indikator-6)
- 3.536 forløb blandt børn og unge under 18 var i behandling med ADHD-medicin i Danmark i perioden 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025, svarende til 68 % [^src2] (danmark, indikator-6)
- Region Hovedstaden opnåede 67 % målopfyldelse for Indikator 6 [^src2] (region-hovedstaden, indikator-6)
- Region Sjælland opnåede 56 % målopfyldelse for Indikator 6 [^src2] (region-sjaelland, indikator-6)
- Region Syddanmark opnåede 72 % målopfyldelse for Indikator 6 [^src2] (region-syddanmark, indikator-6)
- Region Midtjylland opnåede 58 % målopfyldelse for Indikator 6 [^src2] (region-midtjylland, indikator-6)
- Region Nordjylland opnåede 82 % målopfyldelse for Indikator 6 [^src2] (region-nordjylland, indikator-6)

**Epidemiological**
- Antal forløb i ADHD behandlingspopulation for Danmark var 5.222 i perioden 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025 [^src2] (danmark, indikator-6)

**Decision**
- Region Hovedstaden bakker op om styregruppens overvejelse om at placere indikator 6 i supplerende materiale fremover [^src1] (region-hovedstaden, indikator-6)
